mapper.select: SELECT key_id AS "keyId", algorithm, public_key_der AS "publicKeyDer", protected_private_key AS "protectedPrivateKey" FROM t_authorization_jwk WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_authorization_jwk ( key_id, algorithm, public_key_der, protected_private_key, status ) VALUES ( #{keyId}, #{algorithm}, #{publicKeyDer}, #{protectedPrivateKey}, 1 )
